name: memory_geodesic_traverse
description: Follows relativistic frame-dragging angular momentum fluxes (L = x × v) across the memory manifold using symplectic integration to trace multi-hop causal reasoning chains without context window bloat.

start_concept.description: Concept name or node ID to originate the geodesic trajectory from.

max_depth.description: Maximum number of geodesic causal hops to follow (default 3, up to 8).

direction.description: Directional flow: 'forward' follows causal consequences via angular momentum L; 'backward' traces causal roots via -L; 'bidirectional' explores both.
